verdict.rationale: INPI runs online filing portals and data services, so opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookie consent or tracking opt-out. The 'gratuit et confidentiel' line describes confidential advisory support, not usage-tracking controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
